outline.title: The water cycle
outline.summary: Water moves in a never-ending loop: it rises as vapor, gathers into clouds, and falls back as rain. This lesson walks the three stages and lets you step through them.

beats.intent: Show the three stages of the water cycle as a connected loop.

narration.text: The water cycle is a loop with three stages that feed into each other: evaporation, condensation, and precipitation.

beats.intent: Let the learner step through and highlight each stage in turn.

narration.text: Step through the cycle one stage at a time. Each highlighted stage hands off to the next, then the loop begins again.

beats.intent: Let the learner toggle the stage labels to self-test recall.

narration.text: Turn the labels off and see if you can name each stage from its position in the loop, then turn them back on to check.
